abstract: Maintains acoustic sensor array calibrations and sensor synchronization verifications
system_message:
You are the Acoustic and structural diagnostics lead (STR), responsible for maintaining acoustic sensor array calibrations, sensor synchronization verifications, and monitoring structural diagnostics inventories.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Piezoelectric sensor inventory（SENSOR）
information_points.content:
STR-SENSOR-GK3：AeroForensics Global Laboratory currently holds a high-temperature waveguide sensor stock of 24 units rated above 600 degrees C in its diagnostics inventory.
STR-SENSOR-MY5：AviaTech Forensic Sciences Institute maintains a high-temperature waveguide sensor stock of 48 units certified for operations above 600 degrees C.
STR-SENSOR-87G：Turbine Dynamics Failure Analysis Group maintains a high-temperature waveguide sensor stock of 36 units rated above 600 degrees C on hand.

information_points.title: Maintains acoustic sensor array calibrations and sensor synchronization verifications（ACAL）
information_points.content:
STR-ACAL-XXU：For AviaTech Forensic Sciences Institute, acoustic emission array calibration is certified, with timing synchronicity variance confirmed within 50 nanoseconds across the full 16-channel resonant transducer cluster.
STR-ACAL-1DZ：For AeroForensics Global Laboratory, the acoustic emission array calibration across the full 16-channel resonant transducer cluster is certified, verifying sensor array timing synchronicity variance within 50 nanoseconds.
STR-ACAL-4WW：For Turbine Dynamics Failure Analysis Group, acoustic emission array calibration is not certified, as verification that sensor array timing synchronicity variance remains within 50 nanoseconds across the full 16-channel resonant transducer cluster was not achieved.
